data.long_description:
Beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment located in the prestigious Address Harbour Point, Tower 2.

Unit Features:

BUA: 774.36 sq. ft.
Fully furnished with high-quality finishes
Spacious living and dining area
2 modern bathrooms
Private balcony with a comfortable outdoor space
Built-in wardrobes
Fully equipped kitchen with built-in appliances
1 allocated parking space
Vacant and ready to move in

Amenities:

Infinity swimming pool overlooking the waterfront
Fully equipped modern gym
Dedicated kids’ play area
Landscaped podium and leisure areas
24/7 security and concierge services
High-speed elevators
Covered parking
Direct access to the promenade
Luxury hotel-style services by Address Hotels + Resorts

Location:

Address Harbour Point – Tower 2 is ideally located in Dubai Creek Harbour, offering a perfect blend of waterfront living and city connectivity:
Minutes away from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall
Easy access to Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
Close to cafés, restaurants, and retail outlets along the promenade
Well-connected to major highways
Stunning views of Dubai Creek and skyline
